scope: Secondary descriptive summaries added after preliminary nucleotide and viral-reference-only results, before the pooled broad NR search. Primary screen and protein-search parameters remain fixed.
comparisons: Common exact complete trimmed pair sequence keys for both paths; retain original-ID multiplicity separately.
Report all viral-reference candidates, NR viral-only evidence, and two descriptive subsets: both mates aligned to NR, and NR LCA exact/ancestor-related to the viral-reference LCA.
Species support at one, two, and three exact pairs using frozen viral-reference taxonomy; these are descriptive counts, not tuned diagnostic thresholds.
test: A synthetic fixture verifies that duplicate native IDs count once, a new ID with the same complete pair is not an exact-pair gain, and nonviral competition excludes only its own candidate.
limits: Extra assignments do not establish infection or novel viruses.
Reference-only candidates and NR-unvalidated pairs are reported separately.
Native production duplicate marking differs from the common exact-pair comparison.
